permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Sends speech to your chosen AI/transcription provider on request or through opt-in hands-free assistance, captions, or summaries. Optional Tavily search sends transcript queries or game topics. Selected notes accompany analysis. Each service receives only its own credential.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: VeritasLens listens to a rolling in-memory buffer of nearby audio (10 seconds to 5 minutes, configurable). Audio is never written to disk, ages out of the buffer, and is cleared when the session ends.

permissions.name: phone-microphone
permissions.desc: When Phone is selected in Audio settings, VeritasLens captures a rolling in-memory audio buffer using the phone microphone. Audio is never written to disk and is cleared when the session ends.

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Sends your coordinates to BigDataCloud (~once per 30 min) for city/country lookup, and to your chosen LLM provider on every analysis so answers reflect where you are. Coords are never written to History or transcripts. Toggle off in Settings.
